definitions.explanation: The act of preparing and working the land for growing crops.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耕作|こうさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{適|てき}して→適する：02297_tekisuru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This land is suitable for cultivation.

examples.japanese: {耕作|こうさく}⟦{放棄|ほうき}→放棄：12825_houki⟧{地|ち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{耕作|こうさく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧きた。
examples.english: My grandfather has cultivated this field for many years.

notes:
FORMS:
- {耕|こう} (till, plow) + ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (make, cultivate)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耕作|こうさく}{地|ち} (cultivated land, farmland)
- {耕作|こうさく}⟦{放棄|ほうき}→放棄：12825_houki⟧{地|ち} (abandoned farmland)
- {耕作|こうさく}⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧ (cultivated area)
- {耕作|こうさく}{者|しゃ} (farmer, cultivator)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- {耕作|こうさく}⟦{放棄|ほうき}→放棄：12825_houki⟧{地|ち} (abandoned farmland) is a growing issue in rural Japan due to aging farmers and rural depopulation
- About 420,000 hectares of farmland were abandoned as of recent statistics
